s1.quote: Today, the wreck sits upright at an accessible depth of just 30 m (98 ft) where a wide variety of marine life can be admired, from stonefish to colourful reef fish.

s2.quote: most divers start at 28m … The wreck is deep, sheltered and current-free … Ideal for experienced divers

highlights.text: Jaws swim-through, hawksbill turtle, coral growth

summary.text: A sheltered, upright wreck in Neiafu harbour, a short boat ride out. Calm, current-free and deep enough that most dives start near 28 m, it suits experienced divers and shows masts, winches, coral growth and a resident turtle.

sites.name: Historic Dive Wreck Clan Mc William
